title: Speech Transcriber
requirements: Use SFSpeechRecognizer + SFSpeechURLRecognitionRequest for full-file transcription
Ensure only one SFSpeechRecognizer instance exists at a time
transcribe(at audioURL: URL) async throws -> Transcript
Surface speechUnavailable when SFSpeechRecognizer is nil on device
acceptance_criteria: Returns Transcript with source .speech on success
Throws descriptive error when recognizer is unavailable
Never instantiates two SFSpeechRecognizer instances concurrently
